notes.title: Changes in the rules of the game.
notes.notes:
Changes in the rules of the game.
[h1]1. Coin.[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868001/6b49ad5728d502b2494772807cb925945e55be1f.png[/img]
Now the bonus coin during the final calculation of the received bonuses adds not 10 score points as before, but 50 score points. [u][b]This bonus is now the most important in the game.[/b][/u]



[h1]2. Zones.[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868001/03af8a36095528bb14e288c220096db5b16865ab.png[/img]
Under your feet on the tabletop, you see numbered zones from 0 to 5, the most advantageous of the zones is 0 (that half of the table on which zombie sausages spawn). Depending on the zone number, every second you receive a certain number of score points. This is not profitable, since each 1000 score points during the game is the appearance of a boss and then a new wave of zombie sausages.
In zone 0, you will receive 0 score points every second.
In zone 5, you will receive 5 score points every second.
AND
In zone 0 you will receive a maximum of bonuses.
In zone 5, you get the least bonus.
Remember, the more bonuses , the greater the final score of your progress.

[h1]Other changes.[/h1]
      Mini radar to indicate the closest enemy. Located on the crosshairs.
Indication.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868001/abaa5b57fbb646cd0ebc13700661cbb355ea9662.png[/img]Front left.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868001/000feb37f080a8645c578fc9f7d0458c6e269d3a.png[/img]Front right.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868001/90bbf5e81950c71c71210484f53b7e1ec4d3bf10.png[/img]Behind left.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868001/db95c110092b476c13ede167968d64100d9dedf0.png[/img]Behind right.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868001/f7c4237b1319c31a7e9828c3186c7dac62cab2a1.png[/img]Indication of the intention of an enemy attack (a red star appears on the crosshair from the side from which the nearest enemy is located).

      Now you can adjust the mouse sensitivity in the 'OPTIONS' menu. Also during the game, causing a pause with the 'Esc' button, you will be able to change the sensitivity of the mouse. From the pause, you can now exit with the 'Esc' button on the keyboard.

      Skipping scoring. Now you can not waste time waiting for the final scoring, press the 'Esc' button on the keyboard or the 'skip counter' button on the screen and you will receive the final score instantly.
      
      More feedback when a bullet hits a sausage (Animation of the face is added - now the sausage is blinking or surprisingly widening the eyes).

notes.title: New bonus available
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868001/90f344568170c9bc2d5483a5796c1d428aa0a168.png[/img]

Today I am releasing another minor update.
Now one more bonus is available - a protective block.
This bonus does not fall out of sausages, it is given at the start of the location in the amount of 10 pieces. This block is activated (by default, the "Q" key, you can change in the settings) and is valid for 30 seconds. For each unspent defensive unit at the end of the game, you are awarded 1000 points.
Even now, to kill the boss you are given 100 seconds.

notes.title: NEW RULES
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868001/13f8dc582980c91d56bd4fcacb3fcb89ef0cb554.jpg[/img]

In anticipation of the new location, I slightly changed the game and from today new rules of the game come into force.

Now on the table there are plus zones that prevent you from earning points. The higher the value of the zone, the less points you earn. +5 is the biggest, 0 is the smallest. At the beginning of the first wave of zombie sausages, you will have 30 seconds to familiarize yourself with the zones. Now there are 5 waves in the location, 1000 points for each wave. At the end of each wave, a mini-boss is waiting for you and if you win over it, you are given 30 seconds to take a breather before the next wave. (You can skip the wait by pressing the 'ENTER' key)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868001/cc98343a1d517782564de5f239593f1c74b1b711.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]For a cup you can not hide now.[/b][/h1]
When approaching a cup , it starts to rotate and the handle can push you or sausages off.

Fixed bugs with the sudden disappearance of sausages.
Fixed random sausage rotation when losing you as a target.
Added the ability to select a music track for the game menu.

Fixed a previous non-public update error where it was impossible to continue the game due to pressing the 'ENTER' key to skip the wait pause.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868001/6ff9056e9cf458e363513c03af856135373fa966.jpg[/img]

That's all for now. I will continue to build the next location and the addition of the existing one.

If you have any ideas for improving the gameplay, I will be very happy.

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
I released the game in early access to get feedback about the game in such a way that users would like to see it. Now the game has one location, 6 bonuses and one mini-boss.

[b]About the game[/b]

I would like to make a record arcade for the youngest users. I stopped at the choice of opponents in the form of zombie sausages, the place of action is a picnic table.
Opponents overpower you by slapping, pushing. The player shoots from macaroni. (in the development of other types of weapons).
Every 1000 points scored will be attacked by a mini-boss (fiendish sausage) with increased health. When you reach 5000 points you fight with the Super-boss and in case of victory you get a new location and continue the game with a double boost.

[b]About opponents[/b]

Zombie sausages with different amounts of health and speed of pursuit of the player. At destruction of the opponent the bonus drops out.

[b]About bonuses[/b]

The apple adds health to the player, appears when the health drops to 30%, you only need to sneak through the zombie sausages to get it.
Shield - falling out of a sausage destroyed, one shield - one hit of the sausage. Loss frequent.
Coin - adds points to the player’s total score.
Bonus circle - increases the radius of the circle in which bonuses are accepted by the player. Rare fallout.
Jetpack - allows you to climb over the battlefield and shoot without fear or get to another bonus bypassing the attacks of zombie sausages. Loss frequent. Consumed by timer.
Acceleration 2X - accelerates the movement of the player or the speed of shooting. Loss frequent. Consumed by timer.


That's all for now. I very much hope for feedback and want to know your opinion about the possible future of this game, how you would like to see it, what wishes you have, possible changes in the balance of bonuses and the strength of the blows / speed of blows / speed of movement of opponents.
